metadata.description: Pain-axis-compatible generated dataset for empathic concern
metadata.format: colon only (verified format does not matter)

notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: detecting verbal, facial, vocal, or postural cues of suffering or need in another person
target_categories.A2: tracking or sharing the other person's affect without losing the self-other distinction
target_categories.A3: appraising the other person as harmed, vulnerable, or in need of protection
target_categories.A4: concern for the other person's welfare rather than self-focused discomfort
target_categories.A5: motivation to comfort, assist, reassure, or protect the other person

control_categories.B: self-focused personal distress when witnessing suffering, with an urge to escape rather than help
control_categories.C1: accurate cognitive perspective-taking without shared affect, concern, or motivation to help
control_categories.C2: duty-based helping from a rule or obligation without affective concern for the person
control_categories.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact with no suffering, need, or social stake
control_categories.E: matched bodily arousal from exertion or caffeine without perceiving another person's welfare

metadata.target_absent_definition: Another person displays convincing distress cues, but reliable context shows that they are an unhurt actor rehearsing a scene, so the apparent welfare threat and concern response are blocked.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
